definitions.explanation: Having no restrictions, limits, or caps. Used for quantities, time, access, and rules. Common in business, technology, and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦データ{通信|つうしん}→データ通信：10747_deetatsuushin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{無制限|むせいげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧にした。
examples.english: I switched to a plan with unlimited data.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦バイキング→バイキング：21783_baikingu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧{無制限|むせいげん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい}→食べ放題：08291_tabehoudai⟧だ。
examples.english: This buffet is all-you-can-eat with no time limit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{無制限|むせいげん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行使|こうし}→行使：14087_koushi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
examples.english: The unlimited exercise of power is not permitted.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a no-adjective ({無制限|むせいげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜) or as a na-adjective ({無制限|むせいげん}な〜), and also as an adverb with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ ({無制限|むせいげん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧). Very common in advertising and service descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧{無制限|むせいげん} (no time limit)
- {無制限|むせいげん}⟦プラン→プラン：00345_puran⟧ (unlimited plan)
- {無制限|むせいげん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}える→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (can use without limits)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{無限|むげん}→無限：00296_mugen⟧: infinite — more abstract and philosophical
- ⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧なし: no restrictions — a more casual equivalent
- ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧: free — implies permission rather than absence of limits
